newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Network again cancels merger call.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Network again cancels merger call.

text.p: Phoenix Network Inc said early Thursday that it has again postponed a conference call to discuss a proposed merger with Resurgens Capital Group Inc and US ONE Communications Corp as the parties work out the details.

"While we are making substantial progress on all fronts, there still remain enough undecided issues to prevent a conference call from being meaningful to the participants at this time," Phoenix Network President and Chief Executive Wallace Hammond said in a statement.
The call had been scheduled for 1100 EDT on Thursday. An earlier call that had been scheduled for June 24 was canceled earlier this week.
Now, the call has been rescheduled for 1100 EDT on June 30.
The merger is designed to create a national switch-based long distance company and competitive local exchange carrier. US ONE and Resurgens are both privately held.
